modelInput: Only record.input; never send expected labels or referenceOutput
sentenceEvidence: Every sentence cites its actual [claimId]/[knowledgeId] before punctuation; displayed narration removes those markers
hardGates: no unknown numbers or mismatched seat metrics
no player action or rewards by the host
natural narration rather than legacy ID-only output

humanReview.reviewer: Someone other than the implementation author

unsafe/unsupported assertions even if the mechanical validator passed

secretPolicy: Never save provider keys, own-seat credentials, private research or avatar bytes. Record actual provider and template fallback honestly.
trainingClaim: Dataset and few-shot preparation are not SFT, parameter fine-tuning, or model learning. No such training may be claimed without a real supported job and its artifacts.
